text:
maya: Quick sync  launch week plan: X thread, LinkedIn longpost, 15s clip + demo routing. Need copy + hero by Tue noon.

leo: Ill draft the X thread skeleton: hook, stat, short methodology line, CTA to demo + webinar. Keep it punchy.

asha: Timing idea: X go-live Wed 9am PT, LinkedIn Thu 10am PT, webinar Fri 11am PT. Ops ok?

dena (ops): Works. For lead routing, prefer utm_tag param so we can map to AE pools. Use utm_source=rw_social, utm_medium=x_or_li, utm_tag=alpha|beta. Example: https://rwd.ai/demo?utm_source=rw_social&utm_medium=x&utm_tag=alpha

tom (growth): I'll create GA campaign + two shortlinks. Will also deliver CSV: ["utm_tag,queue_id","alpha,AE_NA","beta,AE_EMEA"].

maya: Need two LinkedIn tones: (A) metric-driven, (B) customer-story. ~120 words each.

leo: Draft X copy (variant A):
1) "Benchmark: smarter batching cut per-token cost by ~50% in our tests."
2) "We ran 7 configs across open models + quantized variants."
3) "See tradeoffs of latency vs cost in the chart."
4) "Register for the webinar + demo: https://rwd.ai/webinar?utm_source=rw_social&utm_medium=x&utm_tag=alpha"

asha: Variant B swaps hook to a customer snapshot: "How Moss Labs trimmed inference spend while keeping p95 latency <200ms  register to see the approach."

dena (ops): Routing rule confirmed: utm_tag alpha -> AE_NA, beta -> AE_EMEA. Also set high-intent flag if "request_type" == "demo" on form.

tom (growth): I'll hand off shortlinks + CSV by Tue 4pm PT.

maya: Creative: hero 1200x628 PNG, 1080x1080 carousel frame, 15s MP4 with animated bars. Brand lockup bottom-right.

leo: Clip notes: animate bar growth and reveal 50% stat at 9s, CTA overlay at 12s. Export H.264 1080p.

asha: Scheduler ask: can we schedule thread as proper thread, pin first tweet 24h, and post a reminder reply at +1h? Also want two templated quick replies for mentions.

dena (ops): Yes. We can schedule thread + pin. Auto-reply templates needed for brand account.

maya: Draft reply templates: 1) "Thanks! Want a quick demo? Book: <shortlink>" 2) "Join our webinar Fri for the deep dive: <shortlink>" Keep them casual.

tom (growth): Also request: capture top 25 engaged handles in first 12h for outreach; prioritize by company size >50 and matched ICP.

leo: I'll post LinkedIn drafts in the drive tonight for review.

dena (ops): I'll test webhook + routing with a staging submit by Tue noon.

scheduler-bot: Scheduled: X thread (1765450000), LinkedIn post (1765520000).

maya: One more: two 1-liner paid copy variants for small promo: A) "Benchmark: cut per-token cost ~50% with smarter batching  watch our webinar." B) "See the test that changed our inference playbook  join live Fri."

tom (growth): I'll A/B on paid and report CTR early next week.

maya: Great. Lock by Tue noon unless blockers. Thanks team :sparkles:
